name: Takahara Mitsuki
source: Hideyuki's former co-worker at his office job, a lively girl who just can't seem to stay still. She is impulsive and combative, and while inexperienced she wants to marry and learn the joys of sex as soon as possible. Now a waitress at the cafe helping Hideyuki.
